fields.description: When creating a dependency between a task and an epic, the dependency links the task’s parent epic instead of linking the task itself. This behavior should be based on the ticket heirarchy, not the ticket type. If Epic A is the parent of Task B and Story C, and Task D is the child of Story C. Then a dependency link between Task D and Task B would automatically escalate to a link between Story C and Task B. While a dependency link between Task B and Story C would be created directly. Any two siblings under the same parent may have a dependency relationship. Dependency links outside of the same parent must escalate to the closest shared parent. Tickets with no parent are considered siblings for this purpose.
